# Expensify

> Expensify is an AI-powered expense management platform that automates receipt scanning, expense tracking, corporate card management, and reimbursement workflows for businesses of all sizes.

Expensify provides comprehensive expense management solutions including SmartScan receipt recognition, corporate card issuance and integration, multi-currency reimbursements, travel booking, and seamless accounting software integrations. The platform serves diverse industries from nonprofits to financial services with specialized compliance and automation features.

## Key Topics

- SmartScan technology
- Receipt scanning
- Expense management
- Expensify Card
- Corporate cards
- AI automation
- Reimbursement workflows
- Accounting integrations
- Travel management
- Expense tracking
- Concierge AI
- Multi-currency reimbursements
- Automated data entry
- Mobile app
- Compliance automation
